commands.name: dp
commands.description: Dispatch Pilot: switches, effort lock, recent decisions
commands.output:
Dispatch Pilot is on. Effort lock: none.
Switches (/dp <name> on|off):
  on   signals              records context, limit and cost readings in the debug log; no decision uses them
  on   main-effort          decides the main agent's effort when you send a message
  on   escalation           raises the effort of an agent whose tool calls keep failing
  off  hook-block-failures  counts a call one of your hooks blocked as a failure when deciding to escalate
  on   midturn-effort       re-decides the main agent's effort while a turn runs
  on   dispatched-agents    decides each dispatched agent's model and effort when it is spawned
  on   workflow-agents      decides the model and effort of each agent() of a Workflow script when the main agent submits it
  on   workflow-labels      sets the model and effort of each Workflow agent when it starts, by its label, where the script could not be written into
  on   skill-profiles       rates skills by bilingual profiles a cheap model writes once per SKILL.md version (off: by description)
  on   skills               suggests the skills that fit each message; the full skill listing stays out
  on   find-skill           answers the main agent's find_skill: the skills that fit the work it names
/dp on|off | /dp <name> on|off | /dp lock <low|medium|high|xhigh|max> | /dp unlock | /dp log [N]
